recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future regenerated Administration module diagram reintroduces Organization or removes the actor/ellipsis clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-25932 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration technical correction asking that the Administration module Scheduling and Appointments diagram remove Organization from the Schedule actor targets, add an ellipsis for other allowed actor resources, and add an "(actor)" label under "Schedule for".
initial_application: Commit 24bf2439176ba8fbfab9c9342b71eaef0315790b (#FHIR-25932 Admin Module diagram updates) updated images/administration-module-scheduling.png. That Jira-tagged commit is the apparent source application for the requested diagram change; its source/administration-module.html edits were unrelated Administration module table additions.
additional_context: publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml keep administration-module.html and administration-module-scheduling.png in the current build scope, and the Scheduling and Appointments section includes the image. source/schedule/structuredefinition-Schedule.xml lists Schedule.actor target profiles for Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, CareTeam, RelatedPerson, Device, HealthcareService, and Location, but not Organization. PA May 2022 minutes list FHIR-25932 as a technical correction with no vote required, and community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current diagram omits Organization, includes "..." beneath Schedule for, and shows "(actor)" under the Schedule-for label, matching the Jira resolution and current Schedule.actor definition.
